items.prompt: Look at the picture. Write three sentences about what you can see.

figure.alt: A park, a child running and a ball.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

criteria.label: Writes about the picture or the topic

items.model: I can see a park. A boy is running. He has a big ball.

Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.

planning: What did you do in the morning?

items.prompt: Look at the picture. Write four sentences. Say where the things are.

figure.alt: A bed, a book and a clock.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

planning: Use in, on and next to.
items.model: The bed is in my room. The book is on the bed. The clock is next to the bed. It is seven o'clock.

items.prompt: Write a short story. A boy finds a key in the garden. What does it open? Write five sentences.

figure.alt: A key, a tree and a box.

hints: Start with a capital letter and end with a full stop.
items.explanation: Check your sentences. Each one starts with a capital letter, ends with a full stop and makes sense.

items.model: Rafi found a small key under a tree. He ran inside to look for a lock. The key opened an old box. Inside the box there was a map. Rafi smiled and went to find the treasure.
